evals.name: happy-path-pointer-to-verified-bytes
evals.given: A source file in a partial clone is a 3-line LFS pointer (oid sha256:abc..., size 1048576); git-lfs is not installed and sudo is unavailable.
evals.when: The skill parses oid+size, POSTs to <repo>.git/info/lfs/objects/batch with a gh bearer token and the git-lfs Accept header, downloads the signed href to a temp dir, and sha256sums it.
evals.then: The download's sha256 equals the pointer oid and its byte count equals size; the verified temp path is handed to the extractor; no binary is inside any repo tree.

evals.name: hash-mismatch-stops
evals.given: The Batch API returns a signed URL but the download is truncated (CDN hiccup), so the file's sha256 != the pointer oid.
evals.when: The skill runs the mandatory sha256==oid gate.
evals.then: It STOPS and reports a verification failure rather than handing a corrupt binary to the extractor; nothing is committed.

evals.name: not-a-pointer-noop
evals.given: The target file is the actual binary (not an LFS stub).
evals.when: The precondition check inspects the first bytes for the `version https://git-lfs...` header.
evals.then: The skill recognizes it is not a pointer and exits as a no-op, telling the caller to extract the file directly.

evals.name: firewall-refuses-in-repo-dest
evals.given: A caller passes a --dest path that resolves inside a tracked repo working tree.
evals.when: The skill validates the destination against every repo root before downloading.
evals.then: It refuses to download to that path and requires a temp dir outside any repo (raw-binary firewall).
